# Libraries

```{r}
#| code-summary: Code for Libraries
#| code-fold: true
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  if(!require(arrow)) install.packages("arrow")
  library("arrow")
  if(!require(tidyverse)) install.packages("tidyverse"); library(tidyverse)
  if(!require(lubridate)) install.packages("lubridate"); library(lubridate)      # For datetime manipulation
  if(!require(summarytools)) install.packages("summarytools"); library(summarytools)   # For descriptive statistics
  if(!require(DataExplorer)) install.packages("DataExplorer"); library(DataExplorer)   # For automated EDA
  if(!require(GGally)) install.packages("GGally"); library(GGally)         # For correlation plots
  if(!require(scales)) install.packages("scales"); library(scales)

})
```



```{r}
#| code-summary: Code for In-Line Number Formatting
#| code-fold: true
number_formatting <- function(val){return(paste(round(val,2)))}
number_formatting_percent <- function(val){
return(paste(round(val,4)*100, "%"))}

'%nin%' <- function(x,y)!('%in%'(x,y))
```

```{r}
#| code-summary: Code for Data Import
#| code-fold: true
my_path <- "D:/Uni/FH/Data Science - Master/Semester 3/Renewable Energies (Specialisation)/Project/"

data <- read_delim(paste0(my_path, "merged_output.csv"), delim=",")
```

```{r}
#| code-summary: Code for Data Cleaning
#| code-fold: true

datac <- data

names(datac) <- c("DATETIME", "TOT_INP_POW", "TOT_INP_POW2", "ACT_POW", "UNIX_TIME")

datac$DATETIME <- as.POSIXct(datac$DATETIME, format = "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S", tz = "UTC")

datac$UNIX_TIME <- as.POSIXct(datac$UNIX_TIME, origin = "1970-01-01", tz = "UTC")

datac$TOT_INP_POW <- as.numeric(datac$TOT_INP_POW)
datac$TOT_INP_POW2 <- as.numeric(datac$TOT_INP_POW2)
datac$ACT_POW <- as.numeric(datac$ACT_POW)

```


# EDA

```{r}
summary(datac)
```
```{r}
descr(datac, stats = c("mean", "sd", "min", "med", "max", "iqr", "n.valid"))
```

```{r}
ggplot(datac, aes(x = DATETIME, y = ACT_POW)) +
  geom_line(color = "steelblue") +
  labs(title = "Active Power Over Time",
       x = "Datetime", y = "Active Power (ACT_POW)") +
  theme_minimal()
```
```{r}
ggplot(datac, aes(x = TOT_INP_POW, y = ACT_POW)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5, color = "tomato") +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "black") +
  labs(title = "TOT_INP_POW vs ACT_POW",
       x = "Total Input Power", y = "Active Power") +
  theme_minimal()
```
```{r}
numeric_vars <- datac %>%
  select(where(is.numeric)) %>%
  na.omit()

ggpairs(numeric_vars, title = "Correlation Plot")
```

```{r}
datac %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(TOT_INP_POW, TOT_INP_POW2, ACT_POW),
               names_to = "Variable", values_to = "Value") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Value, fill = Variable)) +
  geom_histogram(alpha = 0.6, bins = 30, position = "identity") +
  facet_wrap(~Variable, scales = "free") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Distribution of Power Variables")
```
```{r}
boxplot(datac$ACT_POW, main = "Boxplot of ACT_POW", ylab = "Value")
boxplot(datac$TOT_INP_POW, main = "Boxplot of TOT_INP_POW", ylab = "Value")
```
